scope: Real owned CPU binary32 rank 0..4 numeric Tensor objects, independent Storage and Version identities, typed public handles and actual multi-frame native execution. This is not complete PyTorch storage or autograd compatibility.
handle_contract: The inherited suite uses unchanged logical client ledger ordinals. Only actual native returned handles or checked earlier-record result references enter Tensor ID fields. All numeric bytes are preserved.
known_open_contracts: Default native backward retains graph/Saved data until public root drop or graph_reset; Torch default releases Saved data.
